zombifiedplayer.spawn.message: A zombified version of yourself now roams this world...
text.autoconfig.zombifiedplayer.title: Zombified Player
text.autoconfig.zombifiedplayer.option.s: Spawn a zombified player after death
If enabled, a zombified player will spawn after the player gets killed by an Undead | default: enabled
text.autoconfig.zombifiedplayer.option.t: Transfer the players Main and Off Hand to the zombified player
If enabled, the Main and the Off Hand of the dead player will be transferred to the zombified player | default: enabled
Transfer the players Armor to the zombified player
If enabled, the Armor of the dead player will be transferred to the zombified player | default: enabled
Transfer the players Inventory to the zombified player
If enabled, the Inventory of the dead player will be transferred to the zombified player | default: enabled
Transfer the players curios items to the zombified player
If enabled, all equipped curios items of the dead player will be transferred to the zombified player | default: enabled
text.autoconfig.zombifiedplayer.option.s: Spawn zombified player no matter how the player died
If enabled, a zombified player will spawn no matter how the player died | default: disabled
text.autoconfig.zombifiedplayer.option.p: Print spawn messages for the zombified player to the chat
If enabled, a message will be printed out in chat that a zombified player has spawned | default: enabled
Print spawn location of the zombified player to the chat
If enabled, spawn location of the zombified player will printed out in chat | default: disabled
text.autoconfig.zombifiedplayer.option.z: If enabled, zombified players can break through doors | default: enabled
text.autoconfig.zombifiedplayer.option.m: If enabled, zombified players are stronger, faster and have more health | default: disabled
Make Zombified Players immune to lava and fire
If enabled, zombified players are immune to lava and fire | default: disabled
text.autoconfig.zombifiedplayer.option.l: If unsuccessful, stop trying to fetch the player skin
If enabled, the mod will stop trying to fetch the player skin after several unsuccessful tries | default: enabled
text.autoconfig.zombifiedplayer.option.s:
[Please note]
For the option below the mod Contagion needs to be installed!
Spawn Zombified Player after death by infection
If enabled, spawn Zombified Player if player died from an infection | default: enabled
